name: Sarah M.
text: This approach changed everything in my studio! I stopped naming intervals first and my students' ears developed so much faster. They actually understand the relationships between notes now instead of just memorizing labels.

name: James T.
text: Interesting theory, but how long does this actually take compared to traditional methods? My students need to pass theory exams and I'm worried about falling behind on curriculum.

name: Monica K.
text: YES! I've been doing this intuitively with my younger students for years and couldn't explain why it worked so well. Great to see it validated in writing.

name: Derek H.
text: This makes sense for relative pitch training, but absolute pitch learners might need a different approach. Has anyone tried this with both methods in the same classroom?

name: Lisa P.
text: Finally someone wrote this down. My high school choir can now identify fourths and fifths by ear within weeks instead of months. The singing first method is a game changer.
